SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. Special Branch No. D 4501 S. 2. Date 16 / 2 / 33 FEBRUARY 1933）
Subject (in full) N. M. Sytin, Soviet Merchant.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [签名]
Nikolay Maximovitch Sytin, Russian, aged 38 years,
arrived in Shanghai from Tientsin on February 4, 1933. He is
employed by Hsin Ki or Hsing Kee Lumber Company, a Chinese concer
dealing in Soviet lumber and connected with "Dalles" (Far
Eastern Lumber Trust). He resides at the Imperial Hotel, 941
Bubbling Well Road where he registered as a Russian emigrant
residing at 4 Woochang Road, Tientsin. It is reported that he
was an officer in the Russian Imperial Army, but for many years
he had been connected with Soviet Circles.
[签名]
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
